subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all patients had COVID-19-related moderate-to-severe ARDS. obese_population: median BMI 31.1 kg/m2 exceeds 30. early_within_48h: manoeuvres performed within 48 h after the start of mechanical ventilation. ptp_target_subgroups: the PL/FiO2 table targets end-expiratory PL above zero (absolute positive end-expiratory PL) with an end-inspiratory PL limit of 20-25 cmH2O; the schema has no separate end-inspiratory-limit code, so only the end-expiratory code is listed. The EIT condition is not a transpulmonary-pressure target and contributes to no PTP subgroup.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap with any COHORTS.md cluster. Single centre (CHRU Nancy, France) with no shared authors or institution with the epvent1/epvent2, mannheim_boesing, mgh_lung_rescue, or angers clusters; enrolment restricted to March 2021, which does not overlap the enrolment windows of those cohorts; no trial registration number reported to cross-check. The paper cites Scaramuzzo et al. but as external prior work, not shared patients.
unclear_items: outcomes[mortality].data[0].arm_label: mortality is cohort-level ('All patients, except for one, were discharged alive') but the schema requires an arm label; assigned to peep_eit arbitrarily — adjudicator may prefer a different convention.
outcomes[oxygenation].data[0].arm_label: baseline PaO2/FiO2 is cohort-level; assigned to lower_peep_fio2 (first condition) arbitrarily.
design.industry_funded: coded false from the conflict-of-interest statement ('conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships'); no explicit funding statement is given.
intervention.peep_titration_target.end_inspiratory_ptp_limit_cmh2o: paper states a range 'below 20–25 cmH2O'; recorded the upper bound 25.
design.n_centers: single centre evident from the affiliation but no explicit number of centres stated.

paired_effects p-values: the paper reports only thresholded significance markers (* and #, both p < 0.05) for Table 1 variables; exact Wilcoxon p-values not given except for the collapse contrast (p = 0.04).
population.ards_definition_used: severity is described in moderate/severe terms but no ARDS definition (e.g. Berlin) is cited.
data_only_in_figure: Bland-Altman limits of agreement for PEEPEIT vs higher PEEP/FiO2 and PEEPEIT vs PL/FiO2 (Figure 1 upper right and lower left panels; biases -5.0 and -3.8 shown in figure, limits not reported in text)
extraction_flags.general_notes: Within-patient physiologic study in which each patient served as own control under four PEEP strategies in fixed sequence. The esophageal-pressure-guided strategy (PL/FiO2 table) is the intervention relevant to this review; the EIT-guided strategy is not esophageal-based. Driving pressures were explicitly not significantly different between conditions, so no paired effects are recorded for that outcome. Cohort-level values (mortality, baseline PaO2/FiO2, Vt, RR) were assigned to a single arm label for schema compliance; see unclear_items.
